This appendix gives the per-base and per-cohort values behind the campaign results that the main text summarises. Every result in it is written by a script directly from the result files of the campaign; no result was entered by hand. \emph{Excess} is the worst-task NLL excess in nats (\S\ref{subsec:setup}), and \emph{shared} and \emph{independent} are the two arms. Where one cohort per arm was evaluated, these are the seed-1 shared cohort and the first independent cohort of the main grid. Tables~\ref{tab:seeds}, \ref{tab:regimes}, \ref{tab:wudi} and \ref{tab:exposure} are not repeated here.
